title: A $1.26 million convention receivable was missing at year-end

beats.text: San Francisco left $1,256,610 in June concessions revenue off its books.

visual.sub: The Convention Facilities Fund omitted a June receivable

beats.text: The entry belonged to the Convention Facilities Fund.
It was money due. The audit did not establish a cash loss.

visual.kicker: The Convention Facilities Fund omitted a June receivable

beats.text: Another entry concerned Treasure Island. Three expenses arrived in the wrong year.

visual.kicker: Three Treasure Island expenses landed in a later fiscal year

beats.text: They totaled $344,434 and belonged to an earlier period.

visual.kicker: Three Treasure Island expenses landed in a later fiscal year

beats.text: A permit fee at Treasure Island went the other way.

visual.kicker: A prepayment moved the other way

beats.text: The authority charged $10,559 before the year the fees covered.
These entries do not add up to one amount of lost cash.

visual.kicker: A prepayment moved the other way

beats.text: The Controller and independent auditors identified the missing entries.

visual.kicker: Independent and internal reviews detected the adjustments

beats.text: The adjustments took time. Auditors considered them immaterial to the overall financial statements.

visual.kicker: Independent and internal reviews detected the adjustments

beats.text: The fiscal 2016 audit marked corrective action implemented.

visual.kicker: Independent and internal reviews detected the adjustments

beats.text: The report does not show when the concessions receivable reached the bank.
